गर्म पृथ्वी लंबी तरंगदैर्घ्य वाली अवरक्त किरणों के रूप में विकिरण उत्सर्जित करती है। कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड तथा जलवाष्प जैसी ग्रीनहाउस गैसें इन अवरक्त विकिरणों को अवशोषित कर चारों ओर पुनः उत्सर्जित करती हैं, जिससे ऊष्मा वायुमंडल में रुक जाती है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
पृथ्वी आपतित दृश्य प्रकाश को अवशोषित करती है और इसे अधिक लंबी तरंगदैर्घ्य वाले अवरक्त विकिरण के रूप में पुनः विकरित करती है, जिसे ग्रीनहाउस गैसों द्वारा रोक लिया जाता है।

answer.text: Incoming ultraviolet radiation is directly converted into radio waves by the ozone layer
Greenhouse gases absorb incoming solar visible light completely and reflect it back to outer space
Earth emits short-wavelength gamma radiation that is trapped by atmospheric nitrogen and oxygen
Earth absorbs incoming visible light and re-radiates it as longer-wavelength infrared radiation, which is trapped by greenhouse gases

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q13 - Distinction between generation of X-rays and Gamma rays

questiontext.text:
Although the wavelength ranges of X-rays and gamma rays partially overlap in the electromagnetic spectrum, they are fundamentally distinguished by:

यद्यपि विद्युतचुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम में एक्स-किरणों तथा गामा-किरणों की तरंगदैर्घ्य परास आंशिक रूप से अतिव्याप्त होती हैं, फिर भी इनमें मूल अंतर किसके आधार पर किया जाता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
All electromagnetic waves travel at the same speed \(c\) in vacuum, are transverse in nature, and carry zero net electric charge.

Step 2: Source and Origin Comparison
According to Sections 8.4.6 and 8.4.7, electromagnetic wave classification is based on how they are produced and detected. X-rays are generated by transitions of inner shell electrons or by bombarding a heavy metal target with high-energy electrons (electronic/atomic origin). In contrast, gamma rays originate from transitions within atomic nuclei during radioactive decay or nuclear reactions (nuclear origin).

Step 3: Verification of Other Properties
Both X-rays and gamma rays are neutral transverse electromagnetic waves travelling at \(3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\) in vacuum.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The fundamental distinction lies in their origin: X-rays arise from atomic electron interactions, while gamma rays originate from radioactive decay of atomic nuclei.

चरण 1: संकल्पनात्मक सिद्धांत
सभी विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंगें निर्वात में समान चाल \(c\) से चलती हैं, अनुप्रस्थ प्रकृति की होती हैं तथा विद्युत रूप से उदासीन होती हैं।

चरण 2: उत्पत्ति के आधार पर अंतर
अनुभाग 8.4.6 एवं 8.4.7 के अनुसार, एक्स-किरणें उच्च ऊर्जा वाले इलेक्ट्रॉनों द्वारा धात्विक लक्ष्य पर बमबारी अथवा आंतरिक कोश के इलेक्ट्रॉनों के संक्रमण से उत्पन्न होती हैं (परमाण्वीय उत्पत्ति)। इसके विपरीत, गामा किरणें रेडियोएक्टिव नाभिकों के विघटन अथवा नाभिकीय अभिक्रियाओं से उत्पन्न होती हैं (नाभिकीय उत्पत्ति)।

चरण 3: अन्य गुणों का परीक्षण
दोनों ही निर्वात में \(3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\) चाल से चलने वाली अनुप्रस्थ विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंगें हैं।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
मूल अंतर इनकी उत्पत्ति का है: एक्स-किरणें भारी धातु पर उच्च-ऊर्जा इलेक्ट्रॉनों की बमबारी से उत्पन्न होती हैं, जबकि गामा किरणें रेडियोएक्टिव नाभिकीय क्षय से उत्पन्न होती हैं।

answer.text: Their origin: X-rays are produced by bombarding metal targets with high-energy electrons, whereas gamma rays originate from radioactive nuclear decay
Their propagation speed: gamma rays travel much faster than X-rays in vacuum
Their polarization: X-rays are longitudinal waves while gamma rays are transverse waves
Their nature: X-rays carry positive electric charge while gamma rays carry negative electric charge

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q14 - Average electric and magnetic energy densities equality

questiontext.text:
In a plane electromagnetic wave travelling in vacuum, how does the average energy density of the oscillating electric field \(u_E\) compare with the average energy density of the oscillating magnetic field \(u_B\)?

निर्वात में संचरित एक समतल विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग में, दोलायमान विद्युत क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_E\), दोलायमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_B\) से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Relevant Formulae
The average energy density of the electric field is \(u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 E_0^2\). The average energy density of the magnetic field is \(u_B = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0}\).

Step 2: Relation Between Field Amplitudes
In an electromagnetic wave in vacuum, \(E_0 = c B_0\), and the speed of light satisfies \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}} \implies c^2 = \frac{1}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Substitution
Substitute \(E_0 = c B_0\) into the expression for \(u_E\): \[ u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 (c B_0)^2 = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 c^2 B_0^2 = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 \left(\frac{1}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\right) B_0^2 = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0} \]

Step 4: Comparison
Comparing the two expressions gives \(u_E = u_B\). The total average energy of the wave is shared equally between the electric and magnetic fields.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
The average energy density of the electric field equals the average energy density of the magnetic field, \(u_E = u_B\).

चरण 1: संबंधित सूत्र
विद्युत क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 E_0^2\) होता है। चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_B = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0}\) होता है।

चरण 2: क्षेत्र आयामों के मध्य संबंध
निर्वात में विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग के लिए \(E_0 = c B_0\) तथा \(c^2 = \frac{1}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\) होता है।

चरण 3: चरणबद्ध प्रतिस्थापन
\(u_E\) के व्यंजक में \(E_0 = c B_0\) रखने पर: \[ u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 c^2 B_0^2 = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 \left(\frac{1}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\right) B_0^2 = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0} = u_B \]

चरण 4: तुलना
दोनों व्यंजकों की तुलना करने पर \(u_E = u_B\) प्राप्त होता है। तरंग की कुल औसत ऊर्जा विद्युत तथा चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों में समान रूप से विभाजित होती है।

चरण 5: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
विद्युत क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व के बराबर होता है, अर्थात् \(u_E = u_B\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q15 - Frequency ranges of television and FM radio bands

questiontext.text:
According to the classification of radio waves in the electromagnetic spectrum, what is the frequency band used for FM (frequency modulated) radio transmission?

विद्युतचुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम में रेडियो तरंगों के वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, एफएम (FM - आवृत्ति मॉडुलित) रेडियो प्रसारण के लिए प्रयुक्त आवृत्ति बैंड क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Radio waves occupy the lowest frequency region of the electromagnetic spectrum and are partitioned into distinct operational frequency bands for various broadcasting applications.

Step 2: Textbook Range Verification
According to Section 8.4.1: The AM (amplitude modulated) band is from \(530\text{ kHz}\) to \(1710\text{ kHz}\). Television waves typically span from \(54\text{ MHz}\) to \(890\text{ MHz}\). The FM (frequency modulated) radio band extends specifically from \(88\text{ MHz}\) to \(108\text{ MHz}\).

Step 3: Distractor Check
\(530\text{ kHz}\) to \(1710\text{ kHz}\) corresponds to the standard AM broadcast band, and \(54\text{ MHz}\) to \(890\text{ MHz}\) encompasses television broadcast bands.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The frequency band used for FM radio is \(88\text{ MHz}\) to \(108\text{ MHz}\).

चरण 1: संकल्पनात्मक सिद्धांत
रेडियो तरंगें विद्युतचुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम के सबसे निम्न आवृत्ति वाले क्षेत्र में स्थित होती हैं और विभिन्न प्रसारण अनुप्रयोगों के लिए विशिष्ट आवृत्ति बैंडों में विभाजित होती हैं।

चरण 2: पाठ्यपुस्तक तथ्यों का सत्यापन
अनुभाग 8.4.1 के अनुसार: AM (आयाम मॉडुलित) बैंड \(530\text{ kHz}\) से \(1710\text{ kHz}\) तक होता है। टेलीविजन तरंगें \(54\text{ MHz}\) से \(890\text{ MHz}\) तक होती हैं। FM (आवृत्ति मॉडुलित) रेडियो बैंड \(88\text{ MHz}\) से \(108\text{ MHz}\) तक विस्तृत होता है।

चरण 3: अन्य मानों की जांच
\(530\text{ kHz}\) से \(1710\text{ kHz}\) AM प्रसारण बैंड है और \(54\text{ MHz}\) से \(890\text{ MHz}\) टीवी प्रसारण रेंज है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
FM रेडियो प्रसारण के लिए प्रयुक्त आवृत्ति बैंड \(88\text{ MHz}\) से \(108\text{ MHz}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q16 - Wavelength band corresponding to radio frequency tuning

questiontext.text:
A radio receiver can tune in to any station in the frequency band from \(7.5\text{ MHz}\) to \(12\text{ MHz}\). What is the corresponding wavelength band? (Take \(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

एक रेडियो रिसीवर \(7.5\text{ MHz}\) से \(12\text{ MHz}\) के आवृत्ति बैंड में किसी भी स्टेशन को ट्यून कर सकता है। संगत तरंगदैर्घ्य बैंड क्या होगा? (\(c = 3 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Lower frequency limit: \( u_1 = 7.5 ext{ MHz} = 7.5 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\). Upper frequency limit: \( u_2 = 12 ext{ MHz} = 12 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\). Speed of wave in vacuum: \(c = 3 imes 10^8 ext{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Wavelength is inversely proportional to frequency: \(\lambda = rac{c}{ u}\). The maximum wavelength corresponds to the minimum frequency, and the minimum wavelength corresponds to the maximum frequency.

Step 3: Step-by-Step Working
For \( u_1 = 7.5 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\): \[ \lambda_1 = rac{3 imes 10^8 ext{ m/s}}{7.5 imes 10^6 ext{ s}^{-1}} = rac{300}{7.5} = 40 ext{ m} \] For \( u_2 = 12 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\): \[ \lambda_2 = rac{3 imes 10^8 ext{ m/s}}{12 imes 10^6 ext{ s}^{-1}} = rac{300}{12} = 25 ext{ m} \]

Step 4: Check and Final Answer
The wavelength range spans from the minimum value \(25 ext{ m}\) to the maximum value \(40 ext{ m}\). The corresponding wavelength band is \(25 ext{ m}\) to \(40 ext{ m}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
निम्नतम आवृत्ति: \( u_1 = 7.5 ext{ MHz} = 7.5 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\)। उच्चतम आवृत्ति: \( u_2 = 12 ext{ MHz} = 12 imes 10^6 ext{ Hz}\)। प्रकाश की चाल: \(c = 3 imes 10^8 ext{ m/s}\)।

चरण 2: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
तरंगदैर्घ्य और आवृत्ति व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होते हैं: \(\lambda = rac{c}{ u}\)।

चरण 3: चरणबद्ध गणना
\( u_1 = 7.5 ext{ MHz}\) के लिए: \[ \lambda_1 = rac{3 imes 10^8}{7.5 imes 10^6} = 40 ext{ m} \] \( u_2 = 12 ext{ MHz}\) के लिए: \[ \lambda_2 = rac{3 imes 10^8}{12 imes 10^6} = 25 ext{ m} \]

चरण 4: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
तरंगदैर्घ्य परास \(25 ext{ m}\) से \(40 ext{ m}\) तक विस्तृत है। संगत तरंगदैर्घ्य बैंड \(25 ext{ m}\) से \(40 ext{ m}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q17 - Velocity of light in non-magnetic material medium

questiontext.text:
In a material medium of permittivity \(\varepsilon\) and magnetic permeability \(\mu\), the speed of propagation of an electromagnetic wave \(v\) is given by:

विद्युतशीलता \(\varepsilon\) तथा चुंबकीय पारगम्यता \(\mu\) वाले किसी भौतिक माध्यम में विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग के संचरण की चाल \(v\) किसके द्वारा दी जाती है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When an electromagnetic wave travels through a material medium rather than free space, the constituent electric and magnetic fields polarize and magnetize the medium.

Step 2: Substitution in Maxwell's Wave Equation
In a material medium, the free space permittivity \(\varepsilon_0\) and permeability \(\mu_0\) in Maxwell's equations are replaced by the permittivity \(\varepsilon\) and permeability \(\mu\) of the medium, respectively.

Step 3: Formula Derivation
According to Eq. 8.11, the resulting wave speed becomes: \(v = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu\varepsilon}}\). The refractive index of the medium is \(n = \frac{c}{v} = \sqrt{\frac{\mu\varepsilon}{\mu_0\varepsilon_0}}\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The velocity of light in a material medium is given by \(v = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu\varepsilon}}\).

चरण 1: संकल्पनात्मक सिद्धांत
जब विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग मुक्त दिक्स्थान के बजाय किसी भौतिक माध्यम में संचरित होती है, तो माध्यम के विद्युत और चुंबकीय गुण तरंग की चाल को प्रभावित करते हैं।

चरण 2: मैक्सवेल समीकरणों में प्रतिस्थापन
किसी भौतिक माध्यम में मैक्सवेल के समीकरणों में निर्वात की विद्युतशीलता \(\varepsilon_0\) और चुंबकशीलता \(\mu_0\) का स्थान माध्यम की विद्युतशीलता \(\varepsilon\) तथा पारगम्यता \(\mu\) ले लेती हैं।

चरण 3: सूत्र निरूपण
समीकरण 8.11 के अनुसार माध्यम में तरंग की चाल: \(v = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu\varepsilon}}\)।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
भौतिक माध्यम में प्रकाश की चाल \(v = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu\varepsilon}}\) द्वारा व्यक्त की जाती है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q18 - Induced magnetic field between circular capacitor plates

questiontext.text:
A parallel plate capacitor made of circular plates of radius \(R\) is being charged by a current \(i(t)\). At a point between the plates located at a perpendicular radial distance \(r\) from the central axis (where \(r < R\)), what is the magnitude of the induced magnetic field \(B\)?

त्रिज्या \(R\) की वृत्ताकार पट्टिकाओं से बना एक समांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र धारा \(i(t)\) द्वारा आवेशित किया जा रहा है। पट्टिकाओं के मध्य केंद्रीय अक्ष से लंबवत त्रिज्यीय दूरी \(r\) (जहाँ \(r < R\)) पर स्थित किसी बिंदु पर प्रेरित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B\) का परिमाण क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Circular capacitor plates of radius \(R\). Charging current in the lead wires: \(i(t)\). Observation point is at distance \(r\) from the central axis with \(r < R\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The electric field \(E\) between the plates is uniform over the plate area \(\pi R^2\) and directed perpendicular to the plates. Edge fringing effects are neglected.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Apply the generalized Ampere-Maxwell law to a circular loop of radius \(r\) centered on the axis: \[ \oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 i_d^{\text{enclosed}} = \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} \]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The electric flux through the circle of radius \(r\) is \(\Phi_E(r) = E \cdot (\pi r^2)\). The total electric flux through the whole plate area is \(\Phi_E^{\text{total}} = E \cdot (\pi R^2)\). Therefore: \[ \Phi_E(r) = \frac{\pi r^2}{\pi R^2} \Phi_E^{\text{total}} = \frac{r^2}{R^2} \Phi_E^{\text{total}} \] Differentiating with respect to time: \[ \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E(r)}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{r^2}{R^2} \left( \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E^{\text{total}}}{\mathrm{d}t} \right) = \frac{r^2}{R^2} i(t) \] The line integral around the loop of radius \(r\) is \(B (2\pi r)\). Equating the two sides: \[ B(2\pi r) = \mu_0 \left(\frac{r^2}{R^2} i(t)\right) \implies B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t) r}{2\pi R^2} \]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(r = 0\), \(B = 0\) as required by symmetry. At \(r = R\), \(B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t)}{2\pi R}\), which matches the magnetic field just outside the plates. The induced magnetic field magnitude is \(B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t) r}{2\pi R^2}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
\(R\) त्रिज्या की वृत्ताकार पट्टिकाएं। आवेशन धारा \(i(t)\)। अक्ष से त्रिज्यीय दूरी \(r < R\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं परिपाटी
पट्टिकाओं के क्षेत्रफल \(\pi R^2\) पर विद्युत क्षेत्र \(E\) एकसमान है तथा किनारों के प्रभाव नगण्य हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
त्रिज्या \(r\) के वृत्तीय लूप के लिए ऐम्पियर-मैक्सवेल नियम: \[ \oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} \]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
त्रिज्या \(r\) के लूप से सम्बद्ध विद्युत फ्लक्स \(\Phi_E(r) = E (\pi r^2) = \frac{r^2}{R^2} \Phi_E^{\text{total}}\) होता है। अतः परिबद्ध विस्थापन धारा: \[ i_d(r) = \frac{r^2}{R^2} i(t) \] रेखा समाकल \(B(2\pi r)\) के बराबर रखने पर: \[ B(2\pi r) = \mu_0 \frac{r^2}{R^2} i(t) \implies B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t) r}{2\pi R^2} \]

चरण 5: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
\(r = 0\) पर \(B = 0\) तथा \(r = R\) पर \(B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t)}{2\pi R}\) प्राप्त होता है जो सततता को संतुष्ट करता है। प्रेरित चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B = \frac{\mu_0 i(t) r}{2\pi R^2}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q19 - Rate of change of potential difference across capacitor

questiontext.text:
A parallel plate capacitor is formed by two circular plates each of radius \(12\text{ cm}\), separated by a distance of \(5.0\text{ mm}\). The capacitor is charged by a constant current of \(0.15\text{ A}\). What is the rate of change of potential difference between the plates? (Take \(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ C}^2\text{N}^{-1}\text{m}^{-2}\))

प्रत्येक \(12\text{ cm}\) त्रिज्या वाली दो वृत्ताकार पट्टिकाओं को \(5.0\text{ mm}\) की दूरी पर रखकर एक समांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र बनाया गया है। संधारित्र को \(0.15\text{ A}\) की स्थिर धारा द्वारा आवेशित किया जाता है। पट्टिकाओं के मध्य विभवांतर के परिवर्तन की दर क्या होगी? (\(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ C}^2\text{N}^{-1}\text{m}^{-2}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Radius of plates: \(R = 12\text{ cm} = 0.12\text{ m}\). Separation: \(d = 5.0\text{ mm} = 5.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}\). Charging current: \(i = 0.15\text{ A}\). Permittivity: \(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Ideal parallel plate capacitor with uniform electric field between circular plates.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Capacitance is \(C = \frac{\varepsilon_0 A}{d} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \pi R^2}{d}\). The charge is related to potential difference by \(Q = C V\). Since \(C\) is constant, differentiating gives: \[ i = \frac{\mathrm{d}Q}{\mathrm{d}t} = C \\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} \implies \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{i}{C} \]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the plate area: \[ A = \pi R^2 = \pi (0.12\text{ m})^2 = 0.0144\pi \approx 0.04524\text{ m}^2 \] Calculate the capacitance: \[ C = \frac{(8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}) \times 0.04524\text{ m}^2}{5.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}} = \frac{4.004 \times 10^{-13}}{5.0 \times 10^{-3}} \approx 8.01 \times 10^{-11}\text{ F} = 80.1\text{ pF} \] Now compute \(\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t}\): \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{0.15\text{ A}}{8.01 \times 10^{-11}\text{ F}} \approx 1.87 \times 10^9\text{ V/s} \]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units are \(\text{A/F} = (\text{C/s})/(\text{C/V}) = \text{V/s}\), which is correct. The rate of change of potential difference is \(1.87 \times 10^9\text{ V/s}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
पट्टिका की त्रिज्या: \(R = 0.12\text{ m}\)। पट्टिकाओं के बीच की दूरी: \(d = 5.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ m}\)। आवेशन धारा: \(i = 0.15\text{ A}\)। \(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं परिपाटी
पट्टिकाओं के मध्य एकसमान विद्युत क्षेत्र युक्त आदर्श समांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
धारिता \(C = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \pi R^2}{d}\) तथा \(i = C \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} \implies \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{i}{C}\)।

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
क्षेत्रफल \(A = \pi (0.12)^2 \approx 0.04524\text{ m}^2\)। धारिता: \[ C = \frac{8.85 \times 10^{-12} \times 0.04524}{5.0 \times 10^{-3}} \approx 8.01 \times 10^{-11}\text{ F} \] विभवांतर के परिवर्तन की दर: \[ \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{0.15}{8.01 \times 10^{-11}} \approx 1.87 \times 10^9\text{ V/s} \]

चरण 5: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
मात्रक \(\text{V/s}\) संगत है। पट्टिकाओं के मध्य विभवांतर के परिवर्तन की दर \(1.87 \times 10^9\text{ V/s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q20 - Electric field expression from magnetic field wave

questiontext.text:
The magnetic field in a plane electromagnetic wave travelling in free space along the \(-x\)-direction is given by \(B_y = (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t)\). What is the corresponding expression for the electric field \(\mathbf{E}\)? (Speed of light \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

मुक्त दिक्स्थान में \(-x\)-दिशा में संचरित एक समतल विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग का चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(B_y = (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t)\) द्वारा दिया गया है। विद्युत क्षेत्र \(\mathbf{E}\) के लिए संगत व्यंजक क्या होगा? (प्रकाश की चाल \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Magnetic field component: \(B_y = (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) \sin(k x + \omega t)\), with \(k = 0.5 \times 10^3\text{ rad/m}\) and \(\omega = 1.5 \times 10^{11}\text{ rad/s}\). Wave speed \(c = \frac{\omega}{k} = \frac{1.5 \times 10^{11}}{0.5 \times 10^3} = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Direction of Propagation and Polarization
The phase \((k x + \omega t)\) indicates that the wave propagates along the \(-x\)-direction (unit vector \(-\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)). The magnetic field oscillates along the \(y\)-direction (unit vector \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)).

Step 3: Determining Electric Field Direction
For an electromagnetic wave, the direction of propagation must equal the direction of \(\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}\). If \(\mathbf{E}\) is along \(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\) (the \(z\)-axis), then \(\hat{\mathbf{k}} \times \hat{\mathbf{j}} = -\hat{\mathbf{i}}\), which correctly matches the \(-x\) direction of wave propagation.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Amplitude Calculation
The electric field amplitude is: \[ E_0 = c B_0 = (3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}) \times (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) = 60\text{ V/m} \] Since \(\mathbf{E}\) oscillates in phase with \(\mathbf{B}\), the expression for \(E_z\) is: \[ E_z = (60\text{ V/m}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t) \]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The electric field is perpendicular to both propagation direction (\(x\)-axis) and magnetic field (\(y\)-axis), with amplitude \(60\text{ V/m}\). The expression is \(E_z = (60\text{ V/m}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t)\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र: \(B_y = (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t)\)। \(k = 0.5 \times 10^3\text{ m}^{-1}\), \(\omega = 1.5 \times 10^{11}\text{ s}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: संचरण दिशा एवं ध्रुवण
कला \((kx + \omega t)\) दर्शाती है कि तरंग \(-x\)-दिशा (अर्थात \(-\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)) में संचरित हो रही है तथा चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(y\)-अक्ष (\(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)) के अनुदिश है।

चरण 3: विद्युत क्षेत्र की दिशा का निर्धारण
तरंग संचरण की दिशा \(\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}\) के अनुदिश होती है। यदि \(\mathbf{E}\) सदिश \(z\)-अक्ष (\(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)) के अनुदिश हो, तो \(\hat{\mathbf{k}} \times \hat{\mathbf{j}} = -\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) प्राप्त होता है, जो सही संचरण दिशा है।

चरण 4: आयाम की गणना
विद्युत क्षेत्र का आयाम: \[ E_0 = c B_0 = (3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}) \times (2.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) = 60\text{ V/m} \] अतः विद्युत क्षेत्र का व्यंजक: \[ E_z = (60\text{ V/m}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t) \]

चरण 5: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
विद्युत क्षेत्र \(z\)-अक्ष के अनुदिश \(60\text{ V/m}\) आयाम के साथ दोलन करता है। व्यंजक \(E_z = (60\text{ V/m}) \sin(0.5 \times 10^3 x + 1.5 \times 10^{11} t)\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q21 - Validity of generalized Ampere circuital law and continuity

questiontext.text:
Consider a pot-shaped open surface whose rim is a circular loop of radius \(r\) surrounding the wire leading to a charging capacitor, while its bottom passes entirely between the capacitor plates without touching any conductor. Applying the Ampere-Maxwell law, why is the line integral \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l}\) identical for this pot-shaped surface and for a flat circular disk bounded by the same rim?

एक पात्र के आकार की खुली सतह पर विचार करें जिसका किनारा आवेशित हो रहे संधारित्र से जुड़े तार को घेरने वाला \(r\) त्रिज्या का एक वृत्ताकार लूप है, जबकि इसका पेंदा बिना किसी चालक को स्पर्श किए पूर्णतः संधारित्र की पट्टिकाओं के बीच से गुजरता है। ऐम्पियर-मैक्सवेल नियम लागू करने पर, इस पात्र-रूपी सतह और समान किनारे द्वारा परिबद्ध समतल वृत्ताकार चकती के लिए रेखा समाकल \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l}\) एक समान क्यों होता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The Ampere-Maxwell law states: \[ \oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 (i_c + i_d) = \mu_0 \left( i_c + \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} \right) \] For any open surface bounded by the same perimeter, the value of \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l}\) must be identical.

Step 2: Analysis of the Flat Disk Surface
The flat disk surface intersects the connecting lead wire carrying current \(i(t)\). Through this surface, the conduction current is \(i_c = i(t)\) and the electric flux is zero (or constant), so \(i_d = 0\). Thus, total enclosed current is \(i_{\text{total}} = i(t)\).

Step 3: Analysis of the Pot-Shaped Surface
The pot-shaped surface nowhere intersects the wire; its bottom lies entirely in the dielectric/vacuum region between the plates. Here, conduction current is \(i_c = 0\). However, the time-varying electric field produces an electric flux whose rate of change satisfies \(\varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} = i(t)\). Thus, the displacement current is \(i_d = i(t)\), making the total enclosed current also equal to \(i(t)\).

Step 4: Comparison and Equivalence
Because \(i_c\) through the flat disk precisely equals \(i_d\) through the pot-shaped surface, the right-hand side of the Ampere-Maxwell equation is identical for both surfaces.

Step 5: Final Conclusion
The line integral of magnetic field is identical because the conduction current threading the flat disk exactly equals the displacement current passing through the bottom of the pot-shaped surface.

चरण 1: संकल्पनात्मक सिद्धांत
ऐम्पियर-मैक्सवेल नियम के अनुसार: \[ \oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 (i_c + i_d) \] समान सीमा वाले किसी भी खुले पृष्ठ के लिए \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l}\) का मान सदैव समान होना चाहिए।

चरण 2: समतल चकती पृष्ठ का विश्लेषण
समतल चकती चालक तार को काटती है, अतः इसके लिए चालन धारा \(i_c = i(t)\) तथा विस्थापन धारा \(i_d = 0\) होती है, जिससे कुल धारा \(i(t)\) प्राप्त होती है।

चरण 3: पात्र-रूपी पृष्ठ का विश्लेषण
पात्र-रूपी पृष्ठ तार को नहीं काटता; इसका पेंदा संधारित्र की पट्टिकाओं के बीच स्थित होता है। यहाँ चालन धारा \(i_c = 0\) है, परंतु परिवर्ती विद्युत क्षेत्र के कारण विस्थापन धारा \(i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} = i(t)\) होती है।

चरण 4: तुलना एवं निष्कर्ष
चूँकि समतल चकती से गुजरने वाली चालन धारा, पात्र-रूपी पृष्ठ के पेंदे से गुजरने वाली विस्थापन धारा के पूर्णतः बराबर होती है, अतः दोनों पृष्ठों के लिए समाकल का मान समान रहता है।

चरण 5: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
समतल पृष्ठ से गुजरने वाली चालन धारा और पात्र-रूपी पृष्ठ से गुजरने वाली विस्थापन धारा का मान सर्वसम रूप से बराबर होता है।

answer.text: Because the conduction current threading the flat disk exactly equals the displacement current passing through the bottom of the pot-shaped surface
Because the magnetic field inside the capacitor gap is strictly zero, making the flux vanish
Because both surfaces pierce through conducting metal wires where conduction current flows
Because the displacement current through the pot-shaped surface cancels out the conduction current completely

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q22 - RMS conduction current in capacitor on AC source

questiontext.text:
A parallel plate capacitor with circular plates has capacitance \(C = 100\text{ pF}\). It is connected across a \(230\text{ V}\) AC supply operating at an angular frequency of \(\omega = 300\text{ rad/s}\). What is the rms value of the conduction current in the circuit? (Take \(V_{\text{rms}} = 230\text{ V}\))

वृत्ताकार पट्टिकाओं वाले एक समांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र की धारिता \(C = 100\text{ pF}\) है। इसे \(\omega = 300\text{ rad/s}\) की कोणीय आवृत्ति पर कार्य करने वाले \(230\text{ V}\) के प्रत्यावर्ती (AC) स्रोत से जोड़ा गया है। परिपथ में चालन धारा का वर्ग माध्य मूल (rms) मान क्या होगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Capacitance: \(C = 100\text{ pF} = 100 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F} = 10^{-10}\text{ F}\). Supply voltage rms: \(V_{\text{rms}} = 230\text{ V}\). Angular frequency: \(\omega = 300\text{ rad/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Ideal capacitive circuit connected to sinusoidal alternating voltage source.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The capacitive reactance is \(X_C = \frac{1}{\omega C}\). The rms value of the conduction current is: \[ I_{\text{rms}} = \frac{V_{\text{rms}}}{X_C} = V_{\text{rms}} \cdot \omega C \]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given numerical parameters: \[ I_{\text{rms}} = 230\text{ V} \times (300\text{ s}^{-1}) \times (10^{-10}\text{ F}) \] \[ I_{\text{rms}} = 69000 \times 10^{-10}\text{ A} = 6.9 \times 10^4 \times 10^{-10}\text{ A} = 6.9 \times 10^{-6}\text{ A} = 6.9\text{ }\mu\text{A} \]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units are \(\text{V} \cdot \text{s}^{-1} \cdot (\text{A}\cdot\text{s}/\text{V}) = \text{A}\). The magnitude \(6.9\text{ }\mu\text{A}\) is consistent with a small capacitance connected to standard low-frequency line voltage. The rms conduction current is \(6.9 \times 10^{-6}\text{ A}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
धारिता \(C = 100\text{ pF} = 10^{-10}\text{ F}\)। स्रोत की rms वोल्टता \(V_{\text{rms}} = 230\text{ V}\)। कोणीय आवृत्ति \(\omega = 300\text{ rad/s}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं परिपाटी
ज्यावक्रीय प्रत्यावर्ती वोल्टता स्रोत से जुड़ा आदर्श धारितीय परिपथ।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
धारितीय प्रतिघात \(X_C = \frac{1}{\omega C}\)। चालन धारा का rms मान: \[ I_{\text{rms}} = \frac{V_{\text{rms}}}{X_C} = V_{\text{rms}} \cdot \omega C \]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
दिए गए मानों को प्रतिस्थापित करने पर: \[ I_{\text{rms}} = 230 \times 300 \times 10^{-10} = 69000 \times 10^{-10}\text{ A} = 6.9 \times 10^{-6}\text{ A} \]

चरण 5: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
धारा का rms मान \(6.9 \times 10^{-6}\text{ A}\) (अर्थात \(6.9\text{ }\mu\text{A}\)) प्राप्त होता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q23 - Correct ordering of electromagnetic waves by photon energy

questiontext.text:
According to the quantum relation \(E = h\nu = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\), which of the following correctly arranges the regions of the electromagnetic spectrum in order of strictly INCREASING photon energy?

क्वांटम संबंध \(E = h\nu = \frac{hc}{\lambda}\) के अनुसार, निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा विकल्प विद्युतचुंबकीय स्पेक्ट्रम के क्षेत्रों को फोटॉन ऊर्जा के पूर्णतः बढ़ते क्रम में सही रूप से व्यवस्थित करता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The energy of a single photon is directly proportional to its frequency \( u\) and inversely proportional to its wavelength \(\lambda\): \(E = h u = rac{hc}{\lambda}\). Therefore, increasing photon energy corresponds strictly to increasing frequency or decreasing wavelength.

Step 2: Wavelength Ordering of the Spectrum
In order of decreasing wavelength (from longest to shortest): Radio waves (\(> 0.1 ext{ m}\)), Microwaves (\(0.1 ext{ m}\) to \(1 ext{ mm}\)), Infrared (\(1 ext{ mm}\) to \(700 ext{ nm}\)), Visible light (\(700 ext{ nm}\) to \(400 ext{ nm}\)), Ultraviolet (\(400 ext{ nm}\) to \(1 ext{ nm}\)), X-rays (\(1 ext{ nm}\) to \(10^{-3} ext{ nm}\)), and Gamma rays (\(< 10^{-3} ext{ nm}\)).

Step 3: Photon Energy Evaluation
Because energy increases as wavelength decreases, the sequence of increasing photon energy is: Radio waves < Microwaves < Infrared < Visible light < Ultraviolet < X-rays < Gamma rays.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The correct order of increasing photon energy is: Radio waves < Microwaves < Infrared < Visible light < Ultraviolet < X-rays < Gamma rays.

चरण 1: संकल्पनात्मक सिद्धांत
फोटॉन की ऊर्जा उसकी आवृत्ति \( u\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती तथा तरंगदैर्घ्य \(\lambda\) के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है: \(E = h u = rac{hc}{\lambda}\)। अतः बढ़ती फोटॉन ऊर्जा, बढ़ती आवृत्ति अथवा घटती तरंगदैर्घ्य के संगत होती है।

चरण 2: तरंगदैर्घ्य का घटता क्रम
घटती तरंगदैर्घ्य (अधिकतम से न्यूनतम) का क्रम है: रेडियो तरंगें, सूक्ष्मतरंगें, अवरक्त तरंगें, दृश्य प्रकाश, पराबैंगनी किरणें, एक्स-किरणें तथा गामा किरणें।

चरण 3: फोटॉन ऊर्जा का बढ़ता क्रम
चूँकि तरंगदैर्घ्य घटने पर फोटॉन ऊर्जा बढ़ती है, अतः फोटॉन ऊर्जा का बढ़ता क्रम होगा: रेडियो तरंगें < सूक्ष्मतरंगें < अवरक्त < दृश्य प्रकाश < पराबैंगनी < एक्स-किरणें < गामा किरणें।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
फोटॉन ऊर्जा का सही बढ़ता क्रम: रेडियो तरंगें < सूक्ष्मतरंगें < अवरक्त < दृश्य प्रकाश < पराबैंगनी < एक्स-किरणें < गामा किरणें है।

answer.text: Gamma rays < X-rays < Ultraviolet < Visible light < Infrared < Microwaves < Radio waves
Microwaves < Radio waves < Visible light < Infrared < Ultraviolet < Gamma rays < X-rays
Radio waves < Microwaves < Infrared < Visible light < Ultraviolet < X-rays < Gamma rays
Radio waves < Infrared < Microwaves < Ultraviolet < Visible light < X-rays < Gamma rays

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_MCQ_Q24 - Vector magnetic field determination for electromagnetic wave

questiontext.text:
A plane electromagnetic wave of frequency \(25\text{ MHz}\) travels in free space along the \(+x\)-direction. At a particular point in space and time, the electric field vector is \(\mathbf{E} = (6.3\text{ V/m})\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). What is the magnetic field vector \(\mathbf{B}\) at this point? (Speed of light \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

\(25\text{ MHz}\) आवृत्ति की एक समतल विद्युतचुंबकीय तरंग मुक्त दिक्स्थान में \(+x\)-दिशा के अनुदिश गति कर रही है। दिक्स्थान और समय के किसी विशिष्ट बिंदु पर, विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश \(\mathbf{E} = (6.3\text{ V/m})\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) है। इस बिंदु पर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश \(\mathbf{B}\) क्या होगा? (प्रकाश की चाल \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Frequency: \(\nu = 25\text{ MHz}\). Propagation direction: \(+x\)-axis, represented by unit vector \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\). Electric field vector at the point: \(\mathbf{E} = (6.3\text{ V/m})\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). Speed of light: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnitude of the magnetic field is related to the electric field by \(B = \frac{E}{c}\). The direction of propagation is given by the direction of \(\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}\).

Step 3: Magnitude Calculation
\[ B = \frac{6.3\text{ V/m}}{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}} = 2.1 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T} \]

Step 4: Vector Direction Determination
The wave propagates along \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\). Since \(\mathbf{E}\) is along \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), the unit vector of \(\mathbf{B}\), say \(\hat{\mathbf{n}}_B\), must satisfy: \[ \hat{\mathbf{j}} \times \hat{\mathbf{n}}_B = \hat{\mathbf{i}} \] Using the right-hand rule for cross products, \(\hat{\mathbf{j}} \times \hat{\mathbf{k}} = \hat{\mathbf{i}}\). Therefore, \(\hat{\mathbf{n}}_B = \hat{\mathbf{k}}\), which points along the \(+z\)-direction.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The magnetic field vector is perpendicular to both electric field (\(y\)-axis) and direction of propagation (\(x\)-axis). Combining magnitude and direction: \(\mathbf{B} = (2.1 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T})\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं स्थितियाँ
तरंग संचरण की दिशा: \(+x\)-अक्ष (\(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\))। विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश: \(\mathbf{E} = (6.3\text{ V/m})\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)। प्रकाश की चाल: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\)।

चरण 2: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का परिमाण: \(B = \frac{E}{c}\)। संचरण की दिशा \(\mathbf{E} \times \mathbf{B}\) द्वारा निर्धारित होती है।

चरण 3: परिमाण की गणना
\[ B = \frac{6.3\text{ V/m}}{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}} = 2.1 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T} \]

चरण 4: सदिश दिशा का निर्धारण
चूँकि \(\mathbf{E}\) सदिश \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) के अनुदिश है और संचरण \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) के अनुदिश है, अतः सदिश संबंध \(\hat{\mathbf{j}} \times \hat{\mathbf{k}} = \hat{\mathbf{i}}\) के अनुसार चुंबकीय क्षेत्र \(+z\)-दिशा (\(\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)) में होना चाहिए।

चरण 5: सत्यापन एवं अंतिम उत्तर
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश \(\mathbf{B} = (2.1 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T})\hat{\mathbf{k}}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q01 - Production of electromagnetic waves by accelerated charges

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: An electric charge at rest produces an electrostatic field but cannot generate electromagnetic waves.

Statement II: An accelerated or oscillating charge radiates electromagnetic waves having the same frequency as the frequency of oscillation.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: विरामावस्था में स्थित एक विद्युत आवेश केवल स्थिरवैद्युत क्षेत्र उत्पन्न करता है लेकिन विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें उत्पन्न नहीं कर सकता है।

कथन II: एक त्वरित अथवा दोलन करता हुआ आवेश विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें विकिरित करता है जिनकी आवृत्ति दोलन की आवृत्ति के समान होती है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
According to Maxwell's electromagnetic theory, a stationary charge produces only a static electric field and no magnetic field. Since electromagnetic waves require coupled, time-varying electric and magnetic fields regenerating each other, a charge at rest cannot radiate electromagnetic waves. Furthermore, a charge moving with uniform velocity constitutes a steady current and produces a steady magnetic field, which also cannot radiate energy. Hence, the first statement is true.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
An oscillating electric charge is an accelerated charge. An accelerating charge creates a time-varying electric field, which produces a time-varying magnetic field, which in turn produces a time-varying electric field, and this process repeats as an electromagnetic wave propagating through space. The frequency of the radiated electromagnetic wave matches the frequency of oscillation of the charge. Hence, the second statement is true.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both statements are correct.

चरण 1: प्रथम कथन का मूल्यांकन
मैक्सवेल के विद्युत चुंबकीय सिद्धांत के अनुसार, विरामावस्था में स्थित आवेश केवल एक स्थिर विद्युत क्षेत्र उत्पन्न करता है और कोई चुंबकीय क्षेत्र नहीं बनाता है। चूँकि विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगों के संचरण के लिए समय के साथ परिवर्तनशील परस्पर संबंधित विद्युत तथा चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों की आवश्यकता होती है, इसलिए विरामावस्था में स्थित आवेश विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें उत्पन्न नहीं कर सकता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, एकसमान वेग से गतिमान आवेश भी ऊर्जा का विकिरण नहीं करता है। अतः प्रथम कथन सही है।

चरण 2: द्वितीय कथन का मूल्यांकन
एक दोलन करता हुआ विद्युत आवेश त्वरित आवेश होता है। एक त्वरित आवेश समय-परिवर्ती विद्युत क्षेत्र उत्पन्न करता है, जिससे समय-परिवर्ती चुंबकीय क्षेत्र उत्पन्न होता है, जो पुनः समय-परिवर्ती विद्युत क्षेत्र को जन्म देता है, और यह चक्र दिक्स्थान में तरंग के रूप में संचरित होता है। विकिरित विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग की आवृत्ति आवेश के दोलन की आवृत्ति के ठीक बराबर होती है। अतः द्वितीय कथन सही है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दोनों कथन सही हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q02 - Energy density and transverse nature of electromagnetic waves

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: In a plane electromagnetic wave propagating in free space, the average energy density of the electric field is strictly greater than the average energy density of the magnetic field.

Statement II: In a plane electromagnetic wave, the electric field vector and the magnetic field vector oscillate parallel to each other.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: मुक्त आकाश में संचरित होने वाली एक समतल विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग में, विद्युत क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व से निश्चित रूप से अधिक होता है।

कथन II: एक समतल विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग में, विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश परस्पर समानांतर दिशाओं में दोलन करते हैं।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
In a plane electromagnetic wave in vacuum, the relation between the electric field amplitude and magnetic field amplitude is \(E_0 = c B_0\), where the speed of light is \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\). The average energy density of the electric field is \(u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 E_0^2\), and the average energy density of the magnetic field is \(u_B = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0}\). Substituting \(E_0 = c B_0\) and \(c^2 = \frac{1}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\) yields \(u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 (c B_0)^2 = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 \left(\frac{B_0^2}{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}\right) = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0} = u_B\). The energy is shared equally between the electric and magnetic fields. Hence, the first statement is false.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
Electromagnetic waves are transverse waves. The electric field vector \(\vec{E}\) and the magnetic field vector \(\vec{B}\) oscillate perpendicular to each other, and both are perpendicular to the direction of wave propagation \(\vec{k}\), satisfying \(\vec{E} \cdot \vec{B} = 0\). They do not oscillate parallel to each other. Hence, the second statement is false.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both statements are incorrect.

चरण 1: प्रथम कथन का मूल्यांकन
निर्वात में संचरित समतल विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग के लिए विद्युत क्षेत्र और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के आयामों में संबंध \(E_0 = c B_0\) होता है, जहाँ प्रकाश की चाल \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\) है। विद्युत क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_E = \frac{1}{4} \varepsilon_0 E_0^2\) तथा चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का औसत ऊर्जा घनत्व \(u_B = \frac{B_0^2}{4 \mu_0}\) होता है। \(E_0 = c B_0\) प्रतिस्थापित करने पर \(u_E = u_B\) प्राप्त होता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि कुल ऊर्जा विद्युत और चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों में समान रूप से विभाजित होती है। अतः प्रथम कथन असत्य है।

चरण 2: द्वितीय कथन का मूल्यांकन
विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें अनुप्रस्थ प्रकृति की होती हैं। विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश \(\vec{E}\) और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश \(\vec{B}\) परस्पर लंबवत दोलन करते हैं, तथा दोनों ही तरंग संचरण की दिशा के लंबवत होते हैं (अर्थात \(\vec{E} \cdot \vec{B} = 0\))। वे एक-दूसरे के समानांतर दोलन नहीं करते हैं। अतः द्वितीय कथन असत्य है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दोनों कथन असत्य हैं।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q03 - Applications of microwaves in radar and oven heating

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: Microwaves are suitable for radar systems used in aircraft navigation due to their short wavelengths.

Statement II: In a microwave oven, the operating microwave frequency is specifically selected to match the resonant vibrational frequency of glass and porcelain containers.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: सूक्ष्म तरंगें (माइक्रोवेव) अपनी छोटी तरंगदैर्घ्य के कारण विमान संचालन में उपयोग की जाने वाली रडार प्रणालियों के लिए उपयुक्त होती हैं।

कथन II: माइक्रोवेव ओवन में, प्रयुक्त सूक्ष्म तरंगों की आवृत्ति विशेष रूप से काँच और चीनी मिट्टी के बर्तनों की अनुनादी कंपन आवृत्ति से मेल खाने के लिए चुनी जाती है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
Microwaves have short wavelengths ranging roughly from 1 mm to 0.1 m. Because of their short wavelengths, they can be transmitted as narrow, concentrated beams that suffer negligible diffraction around macroscopic obstacles, making them ideal for detection and navigation in aircraft radar systems. Hence, the first statement is true.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
In a microwave oven, the frequency of the microwaves is chosen to match the resonant rotational and vibrational frequency of polar water molecules present in food items. This energy is efficiently absorbed by water molecules, increasing their kinetic energy and heating the food uniformly. Glass, ceramic, and porcelain containers do not contain resonant free polar water molecules and therefore do not absorb microwave energy significantly, remaining relatively cool. Hence, the second statement is false.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The first statement is correct, but the second statement is incorrect.

चरण 1: प्रथम कथन का मूल्यांकन
सूक्ष्म तरंगों की तरंगदैर्घ्य लगभग 1 mm से 0.1 m के परास में होती है। अपनी छोटी तरंगदैर्घ्य के कारण इन्हें संकीर्ण तथा संकेंद्रित पुंज के रूप में प्रेषित किया जा सकता है, जिससे विवर्तन का प्रभाव बहुत कम होता है। इसी कारण ये रडार प्रणाली तथा विमान संचालन में अत्यंत उपयुक्त होती हैं। अतः प्रथम कथन सही है।

चरण 2: द्वितीय कथन का मूल्यांकन
माइक्रोवेव ओवन में सूक्ष्म तरंगों की आवृत्ति भोजन में उपस्थित ध्रुवीय जल के अणुओं की प्राकृतिक अनुनादी आवृत्ति से मेल खाने के लिए चुनी जाती है। यह ऊर्जा जल के अणुओं द्वारा अवशोषित होकर उनकी गतिज ऊर्जा बढ़ाती है जिससे भोजन गर्म हो जाता है। काँच और चीनी मिट्टी के बर्तन इन तरंगों को अवशोषित नहीं करते हैं और ठंडे रहते हैं। अतः द्वितीय कथन असत्य है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
कथन I सही है लेकिन कथन II गलत है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q04 - Displacement current and magnetic continuity in capacitor

questiontext.text:
Given below are two statements:

Statement I: During charging of a parallel plate capacitor, the conduction current and the displacement current exist with equal non-zero values at every point in space simultaneously.

Statement II: The generalized Ampere-Maxwell law establishes continuity of magnetic field across the region just outside and just inside the capacitor plates during charging.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: एक समानांतर पट्टिका संधारित्र को आवेशित करते समय, चालन धारा और विस्थापन धारा दिक्स्थान के प्रत्येक बिंदु पर एक साथ समान अशून्य मान के साथ विद्यमान रहती हैं।

कथन II: सामान्यीकृत ऐम्पियर-मैक्सवेल नियम संधारित्र के आवेशन के दौरान पट्टिकाओं के ठीक बाहर और ठीक भीतर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र की निरंतरता को स्थापित करता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of the First Statement
During the charging of a capacitor, electric current in the connecting wires is carried purely by real charge carriers, meaning the conduction current is \(i_c = i\) and the displacement current is \(i_d = 0\). In the gap between the capacitor plates, assuming no dielectric breakdown, no real charges move across the vacuum or dielectric, so \(i_c = 0\) and the current is carried entirely by displacement current \(i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt} = i\). Thus, conduction current and displacement current do not exist with equal non-zero values simultaneously everywhere in space; rather, each dominates in distinct complementary regions. Hence, the first statement is false.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Second Statement
The generalized Ampere-Maxwell law is given by \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 (i_c + i_d)\). Just outside the capacitor plates, the circulation integral encompasses conduction current \(i_c = i\) (with \(i_d = 0\)), giving \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 i\). Just inside the gap between the plates, the loop encloses displacement current \(i_d = i\) (with \(i_c = 0\)), giving \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 i\). Because the total effective current \(i_c + i_d\) is continuous, the magnetic field is identical and continuous across the boundary just outside and just inside the capacitor. Hence, the second statement is true.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The first statement is incorrect, but the second statement is correct.

चरण 1: प्रथम कथन का मूल्यांकन
संधारित्र के आवेशन के दौरान, संयोजक तारों में धारा वास्तविक आवेश वाहकों के प्रवाह के कारण होती है, जहाँ चालन धारा \(i_c = i\) तथा विस्थापन धारा \(i_d = 0\) होती है। संधारित्र की पट्टिकाओं के बीच के अंतराल में कोई आवेश प्रवाहित नहीं होता, अतः वहाँ \(i_c = 0\) तथा संपूर्ण धारा विस्थापन धारा \(i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{d\Phi_E}{dt} = i\) के रूप में होती है। अतः दोनों धाराएं प्रत्येक स्थान पर एक साथ समान अशून्य मान में उपस्थित नहीं होती हैं। अतः प्रथम कथन असत्य है।

चरण 2: द्वितीय कथन का मूल्यांकन
सामान्यीकृत ऐम्पियर-मैक्सवेल नियम \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 (i_c + i_d)\) के अनुसार, पट्टिकाओं के ठीक बाहर संवृत पाश केवल चालन धारा \(i_c = i\) को परिबद्ध करता है, जिससे \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 i\) मिलता है। पट्टिकाओं के ठीक अंदर वही पाश केवल विस्थापन धारा \(i_d = i\) को परिबद्ध करता है, जिससे \(\oint \vec{B} \cdot d\vec{l} = \mu_0 i\) प्राप्त होता है। चूँकि कुल धारा निरंतर रहती है, इसलिए पट्टिकाओं के ठीक बाहर तथा ठीक अंदर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र का मान निरंतर और समान रहता है। अतः द्वितीय कथन सही है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
कथन I असत्य है लेकिन कथन II सही है।

answer.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q01 - Properties of electromagnetic wave propagation in vacuum

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: In free space, electromagnetic waves travel at a constant speed given by \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\), which is independent of their wavelength.

Statement II: Electromagnetic waves transport both energy and momentum as they propagate through empty space.

Statement III: The electric field vector and magnetic field vector in an electromagnetic wave vibrate along the direction of propagation of the wave.

Based on the above statements, choose the correct answer:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: मुक्त आकाश में, विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\) द्वारा दी गई एक नियत चाल से संचरित होती हैं, जो उनकी तरंगदैर्घ्य से स्वतंत्र होती है।

कथन II: विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें निर्वात में संचरण करते समय ऊर्जा तथा संवेग दोनों का वहन करती हैं।

कथन III: एक विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंग में विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश तथा चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश तरंग संचरण की दिशा के अनुदिश कंपन करते हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आधार पर सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of Statement I
From Maxwell's equations, the speed of electromagnetic waves in vacuum is given by \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\), where \(\mu_0\) is the permeability and \(\varepsilon_0\) is the permittivity of free space. Experimental measurements across the entire spectrum (from gamma rays to radio waves) demonstrate that this speed is an invariant constant in vacuum, totally independent of frequency or wavelength. Thus, the first statement is true.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statement II
Electromagnetic waves are self-sustaining oscillating electric and magnetic fields that carry both energy density and momentum density through space. When electromagnetic radiation strikes a material surface, it exerts radiation pressure due to the transfer of momentum. Thus, the second statement is true.

Step 3: Evaluation of Statement III
Electromagnetic waves are strictly transverse waves in free space. The oscillating electric field vector \(\vec{E}\) and the oscillating magnetic field vector \(\vec{B}\) are mutually perpendicular to each other and both are perpendicular to the propagation vector \(\vec{k}\) (the direction of wave propagation), satisfying \(\vec{E} \cdot \vec{k} = 0\) and \(\vec{B} \cdot \vec{k} = 0\). They do not vibrate along the direction of propagation. Thus, the third statement is false.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Statements I and II are correct, but Statement III is incorrect.

चरण 1: कथन I का मूल्यांकन
मैक्सवेल के समीकरणों के अनुसार, निर्वात में विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगों की चाल \(c = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\mu_0 \varepsilon_0}}\) द्वारा दी जाती है, जहाँ \(\mu_0\) मुक्त आकाश की पारगम्यता तथा \(\varepsilon_0\) विद्युतशीलता है। संपूर्ण स्पेक्ट्रम (गामा किरणों से लेकर रेडियो तरंगों तक) के लिए यह चाल निर्वात में एक नियतांक है और तरंगदैर्घ्य अथवा आवृत्ति पर निर्भर नहीं करती है। अतः कथन I सही है।

चरण 2: कथन II का मूल्यांकन
विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें दिक्स्थान में संचरित होते समय ऊर्जा और संवेग दोनों का संवहन करती हैं। जब ये तरंगें किसी सतह पर आपतित होती हैं, तो संवेग हस्तांतरण के कारण वे विकिरण दाब आरोपित करती हैं। अतः कथन II सही है।

चरण 3: कथन III का मूल्यांकन
मुक्त आकाश में विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें अनुप्रस्थ तरंगें होती हैं। विद्युत क्षेत्र सदिश \(\vec{E}\) और चुंबकीय क्षेत्र सदिश \(\vec{B}\) परस्पर लंबवत होते हैं तथा दोनों ही तरंग संचरण की दिशा के लंबवत होते हैं (अर्थात \(\vec{E} \cdot \vec{k} = 0\) और \(\vec{B} \cdot \vec{k} = 0\))। वे संचरण की दिशा के अनुदिश कंपन नहीं करते हैं। अतः कथन III गलत है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
कथन I और II सही हैं, लेकिन कथन III गलत है।

answer.text: Statements I and II are correct, but Statement III is incorrect.
Statements I and III are correct, but Statement II is incorrect.
Statements II and III are correct, but Statement I is incorrect.
All Statements I, II, and III are correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETICWAVES_STMT_Q02 - Production and characteristics of electromagnetic spectrum regions

questiontext.text:
Given below are three statements:

Statement I: Infrared waves are produced by the vibration of atoms and molecules in hot bodies and are commonly termed heat waves.

Statement II: Ultraviolet radiation has shorter wavelengths than visible light and can be focused into narrow beams for LASIK eye surgery.

Statement III: X-rays have longer wavelengths than visible light and are typically produced by the radioactive decay of atomic nuclei.

Based on the above statements, choose the correct answer:

नीचे तीन कथन दिए गए हैं:

कथन I: अवरक्त तरंगें गर्म पिंडों में परमाणुओं और अणुओं के कंपन द्वारा उत्पन्न होती हैं तथा इन्हें सामान्यतः ऊष्मा तरंगें कहा जाता है।

कथन II: पराबैंगनी विकिरण की तरंगदैर्घ्य दृश्य प्रकाश से छोटी होती है और इसे लैसिक (LASIK) नेत्र शल्यचिकित्सा के लिए संकीर्ण पुंजों में केंद्रित किया जा सकता है।

कथन III: एक्स-किरणों की तरंगदैर्घ्य दृश्य प्रकाश से अधिक होती है और ये सामान्यतः परमाणु के नाभिक के रेडियोऐक्टिव क्षय द्वारा उत्पन्न होती हैं।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आधार पर सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Evaluation of Statement I
Infrared radiation lies adjacent to the low-frequency end of the visible spectrum and is produced by thermal vibrations and rotations of atoms and molecules in hot substances. Water and other molecules readily absorb infrared waves, increasing their thermal kinetic energy and raising temperature, which is why they are often called heat waves. Thus, the first statement is true.

Step 2: Evaluation of Statement II
Ultraviolet radiation spans wavelengths from approximately 400 nm down to 0.6 nm, which is distinctly shorter than visible light (700 nm to 400 nm). Because of these short wavelengths, ultraviolet rays experience very little diffraction and can be focused into extremely narrow, high-precision beams suitable for corneal LASIK eye surgery. Thus, the second statement is true.

Step 3: Evaluation of Statement III
X-rays occupy the wavelength range from about 10 nm down to \(10^{-4}\) nm, which is much shorter (not longer) than visible light. Moreover, X-rays are typically produced by bombarding a heavy metal target with high-energy electrons or inner-shell electronic transitions, whereas radioactive nuclear decay produces gamma rays. Thus, the third statement is false.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Statements I and II are correct, but Statement III is incorrect.

चरण 1: कथन I का मूल्यांकन
अवरक्त विकिरण दृश्य स्पेक्ट्रम के कम आवृत्ति वाले सिरे के निकट स्थित होता है और गर्म पदार्थों में परमाणुओं और अणुओं के तापीय कंपनों द्वारा उत्पन्न होता है। जल तथा अन्य अणु इन तरंगों को आसानी से अवशोषित कर लेते हैं जिससे उनकी तापीय गतिज ऊर्जा तथा तापमान बढ़ जाता है, इसलिए इन्हें ऊष्मा तरंगें कहा जाता है। अतः कथन I सही है।

चरण 2: कथन II का मूल्यांकन
पराबैंगनी विकिरण की तरंगदैर्घ्य लगभग 400 nm से 0.6 nm तक होती है, जो दृश्य प्रकाश (700 nm से 400 nm) से छोटी है। छोटी तरंगदैर्घ्य के कारण इसे अत्यंत संकीर्ण तथा परिशुद्ध पुंज में केंद्रित किया जा सकता है, जिसका उपयोग लैसिक नेत्र शल्यचिकित्सा में किया जाता है। अतः कथन II सही है।

चरण 3: कथन III का मूल्यांकन
एक्स-किरणों की तरंगदैर्घ्य लगभग 10 nm से \(10^{-4}\) nm तक होती है, जो दृश्य प्रकाश से बहुत छोटी (अधिक नहीं) होती है। इसके अतिरिक्त, एक्स-किरणें भारी धातु लक्ष्य पर उच्च ऊर्जा वाले इलेक्ट्रॉनों की बमबारी से उत्पन्न होती हैं, जबकि नाभिकीय क्षय से गामा किरणें उत्पन्न होती हैं। अतः कथन III गलत है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
कथन I और II सही हैं, लेकिन कथन III गलत है।

answer.text: Statement I is correct, but Statements II and III are incorrect.
Statements I and II are correct, but Statement III is incorrect.
Statements II and III are correct, but Statement I is incorrect.
All Statements I, II, and III are incorrect.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS12_CH08_MATCH_Q01 - Production mechanisms of different electromagnetic wave bands

questiontext.text:
Match the entries in List I with the corresponding entries in List II:

List I (Electromagnetic Wave)List II (Production Mechanism)
A. Radio wavesI. Klystron valve or magnetron valve
B. MicrowavesII. Radioactive decay of the atomic nucleus
C. Infrared wavesIII. Rapid acceleration and deceleration of electrons in aerials
D. Gamma raysIV. Vibration of atoms and molecules in hot bodies

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Framework
According to Maxwell's electromagnetic theory and experimental classifications, different bands of the electromagnetic spectrum originate from distinct physical processes depending on the nature of charge acceleration, molecular transitions, or nuclear disintegrations.

Step 2: Analysis for Radio Waves
Radio waves possess long wavelengths exceeding 0.1 m and are produced by the rapid acceleration and deceleration of electrons flowing back and forth in transmitting aerials. Thus, entry A pairs with entry III.

Step 3: Analysis for Microwaves
Microwaves occupy the gigahertz frequency domain and are produced by specialized vacuum electronic oscillator devices such as klystron tubes, magnetrons, or Gunn diodes. Thus, entry B pairs with entry I.

Step 4: Analysis for Infrared Waves
Infrared radiation is emitted through the thermal vibrations and rotations of atoms and molecules in heated matter. Thus, entry C pairs with entry IV.

Step 5: Analysis for Gamma Rays
Gamma rays occupy the highest frequency region of the electromagnetic spectrum and are produced by radioactive transitions within atomic nuclei during nuclear decay. Thus, entry D pairs with entry II.

Step 6: Final Mapping
Combining all individual evaluations yields the complete match: A-III, B-I, C-IV, D-II.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS12_CH08_MATCH_Q02 - Detection methods for various electromagnetic spectrum radiations

questiontext.text:
Match the entries in List I with the corresponding entries in List II:

List I (Electromagnetic Wave)List II (Detection Method)
A. MicrowavesI. Thermopiles or bolometers
B. Infrared wavesII. Point contact diodes
C. Ultraviolet raysIII. Geiger-Müller tubes or ionization chambers
D. X-raysIV. Photocells or photographic film

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Framework
Detection of electromagnetic radiation relies on energy conversion mechanisms appropriate to each frequency range, including semiconductor rectification, thermal resistance variation, photoelectric emission, and gas ionization.

Step 2: Analysis for Microwaves
Microwaves induce high-frequency alternating currents at microwave junctions that are rectified and detected by point contact diodes or crystal detectors. Thus, entry A pairs with entry II.

Step 3: Analysis for Infrared Waves
Infrared waves deliver thermal energy that heats absorber elements, altering electric resistance in bolometers or generating thermoelectric voltages in thermopiles. Thus, entry B pairs with entry I.

Step 4: Analysis for Ultraviolet Rays
Ultraviolet photons possess sufficient quantum energy to release photoelectrons in photocells and chemically reduce silver halide crystals on photographic film. Thus, entry C pairs with entry IV.

Step 5: Analysis for X-rays
High-energy X-ray photons ionize gas atoms, producing electric discharge pulses measurable by Geiger-Müller tubes and ionization chambers. Thus, entry D pairs with entry III.

Step 6: Final Mapping
Combining all individual evaluations yields the complete match: A-II, B-I, C-IV, D-III.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS12_CH08_MATCH_Q03 - Technological and medical applications of electromagnetic radiations

questiontext.text:
Match the entries in List I with the corresponding entries in List II:

List I (Electromagnetic Radiation)List II (Prominent Application)
A. MicrowavesI. Remote control switches for household electronics
B. Infrared radiationII. LASIK eye surgery and germicidal water purifiers
C. Ultraviolet raysIII. Aircraft navigation radar and speed guns
D. X-raysIV. Medical diagnostic bone imaging and cancer therapy

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Framework
The interaction of electromagnetic waves with matter depends on their photon energy and wavelength, making specific bands ideal for radar reflection, thermal signaling, precise photochemical cutting, or deep penetration.

Step 2: Analysis for Microwaves
Due to their short wavelengths, microwaves can be focused into highly directional beams with low diffraction spread, making them standard for aircraft navigation radar systems and traffic speed guns. Thus, entry A pairs with entry III.

Step 3: Analysis for Infrared Radiation
Infrared radiation emitted by semiconductor light emitting diodes (LEDs) is widely employed for short-range optical wireless transmission in remote control switches for televisions and electronic systems. Thus, entry B pairs with entry I.

Step 4: Analysis for Ultraviolet Rays
Because of their short wavelength, ultraviolet laser beams can be focused with sub-micrometer precision for LASIK eye corneal reshaping, and UV lamps disrupt microbial DNA in water purifiers. Thus, entry C pairs with entry II.

Step 5: Analysis for X-rays
X-rays pass easily through soft tissues but are attenuated by dense bone structures, making them fundamental for medical radiography as well as radiation oncology. Thus, entry D pairs with entry IV.

Step 6: Final Mapping
Combining all individual evaluations yields the complete match: A-III, B-I, C-II, D-IV.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_CLASS12_CH08_MATCH_Q04 - Maxwell fundamental equations and corresponding physical laws

questiontext.text:
Match the entries in List I with the corresponding entries in List II:

List I (Maxwell's Equation)List II (Governing Law / Physical Principle)
A. \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A} = \frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}\)I. Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction
B. \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A} = 0\)II. Absence of isolated magnetic monopoles
C. \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = -\frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_B}{\mathrm{d}t}\)III. Generalized Ampere-Maxwell law with displacement current
D. \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 i_c + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t}\)IV. Gauss's law for electrostatics

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Framework
Maxwell's four equations represent the complete synthesis of classical electricity and magnetism, unifying static source relationships, inductive field generation, and magnetic flux continuity.

Step 2: Analysis for Surface Integral of Electric Field
The surface integral \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A} = \frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}\) relates the net outward electric flux through any closed surface to the net enclosed electric charge, which is Gauss's law for electricity. Thus, entry A pairs with entry IV.

Step 3: Analysis for Surface Integral of Magnetic Field
The surface integral \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{A} = 0\) over any closed surface expresses the experimental reality that magnetic field lines are continuous closed loops without start or end points, meaning magnetic monopoles do not exist. Thus, entry B pairs with entry II.

Step 4: Analysis for Line Integral of Electric Field
The line integral \(\oint \mathbf{E} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = -\frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_B}{\mathrm{d}t}\) around a closed contour represents the induced electromotive force generated by a changing magnetic flux, which is Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction. Thus, entry C pairs with entry I.

Step 5: Analysis for Line Integral of Magnetic Field
The line integral \(\oint \mathbf{B} \cdot \mathrm{d}\mathbf{l} = \mu_0 i_c + \mu_0 \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t}\) incorporates both physical conduction current and displacement current due to changing electric flux, which is the generalized Ampere-Maxwell law. Thus, entry D pairs with entry III.

Step 6: Final Mapping
Combining all individual evaluations yields the complete match: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q01 - Peak magnetic field from electric field amplitude

questiontext.text: A plane electromagnetic wave propagates in vacuum. At a given point, the amplitude of the oscillating electric field is \(E_0 = 90\text{ V/m}\). What is the amplitude of the oscillating magnetic field \(B_0\) at this point? (Take the speed of light in vacuum \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Electric field amplitude: \(E_0 = 90\text{ V/m}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
In a plane electromagnetic wave travelling in vacuum, the peak amplitudes of the coupled electric and magnetic fields are related by the wave velocity.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[B_0 = \frac{E_0}{c}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the given values into the formula:
\[B_0 = \frac{90\text{ V/m}}{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}} = 3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The unit is \(\text{V}\cdot\text{s}/\text{m}^2 = \text{Tesla (T)}\). The computed magnetic field amplitude is \(3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The amplitude of the oscillating magnetic field is \(3.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q02 - Wavelength calculation in frequency modulated radio band

questiontext.text: An FM radio station broadcasts electromagnetic waves at a carrier frequency of \(100\text{ MHz}\). What is the wavelength of these radio waves in vacuum? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Carrier frequency: \(\nu = 100\text{ MHz} = 100 \times 10^6\text{ Hz} = 1.0 \times 10^8\text{ s}^{-1}\).
Propagation speed in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
Radio waves are electromagnetic waves that propagate at the speed of light in vacuum.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[c = \nu \lambda \implies \lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the values:
\[\lambda = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{1.0 \times 10^8\text{ s}^{-1}} = 3.0\text{ m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The wavelength is \(3.0\text{ m}\), which is consistent with the standard VHF radio band.

Final Conceptual Answer:
The wavelength of the radio waves is \(3.0\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q03 - Frequency determination from visible light wavelength

questiontext.text: A beam of red light has a wavelength of \(\lambda = 600\text{ nm}\) in vacuum. What is the oscillation frequency of this electromagnetic wave? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Wavelength: \(\lambda = 600\text{ nm} = 600 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m} = 6.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
Visible light consists of electromagnetic waves governed by the universal wave speed equation.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[\nu = \frac{c}{\lambda}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[\nu = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{6.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ m}} = 0.50 \times 10^{15}\text{ Hz} = 5.0 \times 10^{14}\text{ Hz}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The optical frequency of \(5.0 \times 10^{14}\text{ Hz}\) falls squarely within the visible range (\(4 \times 10^{14}\text{ Hz}\) to \(7 \times 10^{14}\text{ Hz}\)).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The oscillation frequency is \(5.0 \times 10^{14}\text{ Hz}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q04 - Angular frequency from electromagnetic wave frequency

questiontext.text: A plane electromagnetic wave travelling in free space has a frequency of \(\nu = 25\text{ MHz}\). What is the angular frequency \(\omega\) of this wave? (Use \(\pi = 3.14\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Frequency: \(\nu = 25\text{ MHz} = 2.5 \times 10^7\text{ Hz}\).
Constant: \(\pi = 3.14\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The angular frequency \(\omega\) describes the radian rate of phase variation per unit time.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[\omega = 2\pi \nu\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[\omega = 2 \times 3.14 \times (2.5 \times 10^7\text{ s}^{-1}) = 6.28 \times 2.5 \times 10^7\text{ rad/s} = 1.57 \times 10^8\text{ rad/s}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{rad/s}\). The computed angular frequency is \(1.57 \times 10^8\text{ rad/s}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The angular frequency is \(1.57 \times 10^8\text{ rad/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q05 - Displacement current from charging rate of capacitor

questiontext.text: During the charging of a capacitor, the charge on its plates increases at a constant rate of \(0.40\text{ C/s}\). What is the instantaneous displacement current across the region between the plates?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Rate of increase of plate charge: \(\frac{\mathrm{d}Q}{\mathrm{d}t} = 0.40\text{ C/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
Electric flux between parallel plates of area \(A\) is \(\Phi_E = \frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}\). Maxwell's displacement current is \(i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}\left(\frac{Q}{\varepsilon_0}\right) = \frac{\mathrm{d}Q}{\mathrm{d}t}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[i_d = 0.40\text{ C/s} = 0.40\text{ A}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
By current continuity, the displacement current equals the rate of change of charge on the plates, \(0.40\text{ A}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The displacement current is \(0.40\text{ A}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q06 - Wave propagation number from microwave wavelength

questiontext.text: A microwave has a wavelength of \(\lambda = 3.0\text{ cm}\) in free space. What is the magnitude of its propagation wave vector \(k\)? (Use \(\pi = 3.1416\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Wavelength: \(\lambda = 3.0\text{ cm} = 0.030\text{ m}\).
Constant: \(\pi = 3.1416\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The wave vector magnitude (wave number) \(k\) is related to wavelength by the spatial radian rate.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[k = \frac{2\pi}{\lambda}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[k = \frac{2 \times 3.1416}{0.030\text{ m}} = \frac{6.2832}{0.030} \approx 209.4\text{ rad/m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{rad/m}\). The wave number is \(209.4\text{ rad/m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The magnitude of the wave vector is \(209.4\text{ rad/m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q07 - Electric amplitude from small magnetic amplitude

questiontext.text: The magnetic field amplitude of an electromagnetic wave travelling in free space is \(B_0 = 2.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T}\). What is the electric field amplitude \(E_0\) of the wave? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Magnetic field amplitude: \(B_0 = 2.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
For an electromagnetic wave in free space, the electric field amplitude is directly proportional to the magnetic field amplitude.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[E_0 = c B_0\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[E_0 = (3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}) \times (2.0 \times 10^{-8}\text{ T}) = 6.0\text{ V/m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{V/m}\). The electric field amplitude is \(6.0\text{ V/m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The electric field amplitude is \(6.0\text{ V/m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q08 - Rate of electric flux change in capacitor

questiontext.text: A conduction current of \(0.885\text{ A}\) flows into a parallel plate capacitor during charging. What is the time rate of change of electric flux \(\frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t}\) between the plates? (Take \(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ C}^2\text{N}^{-1}\text{m}^{-2}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Conduction current: \(i_c = 0.885\text{ A}\).
Permittivity of free space: \(\varepsilon_0 = 8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
Inside the capacitor, the current is purely displacement current: \(i_d = i_c = 0.885\text{ A}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[i_d = \varepsilon_0 \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} \implies \frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{i_d}{\varepsilon_0}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the numerical values:
\[\frac{\mathrm{d}\Phi_E}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{0.885\text{ A}}{8.85 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F/m}} = 1.0 \times 10^{11}\text{ V}\cdot\text{m/s}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{A}/(\text{C}^2/(\text{N}\cdot\text{m}^2)) = \text{N}\cdot\text{m}^2/(\text{C}\cdot\text{s}) = \text{V}\cdot\text{m/s}\). The rate of flux change is \(1.0 \times 10^{11}\text{ V}\cdot\text{m/s}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The rate of change of electric flux is \(1.0 \times 10^{11}\text{ V}\cdot\text{m/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q09 - Voltage slew rate across charging capacitor

questiontext.text: A capacitor of capacitance \(C = 20\text{ pF}\) is charged by a constant current of \(0.05\text{ A}\). At what rate does the potential difference \(V\) across the capacitor increase?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Capacitance: \(C = 20\text{ pF} = 20 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F}\).
Charging current: \(i = 0.05\text{ A}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The charge on the capacitor is related to the potential difference by \(Q = C V\). Since \(C\) is constant, differentiating yields \(i = C \frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{i}{C}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the values:
\[\frac{\mathrm{d}V}{\mathrm{d}t} = \frac{0.05\text{ A}}{20 \times 10^{-12}\text{ F}} = \frac{5.0 \times 10^{-2}}{2.0 \times 10^{-11}} = 2.5 \times 10^9\text{ V/s}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{A/F} = \text{V/s}\). The rate of potential difference increase is \(2.5 \times 10^9\text{ V/s}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The potential difference increases at a rate of \(2.5 \times 10^9\text{ V/s}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q10 - Electric field amplitude from magnetic field amplitude

questiontext.text: The magnetic field part of a harmonic electromagnetic wave in vacuum has an amplitude of \(B_0 = 320\text{ nT}\). What is the amplitude of the electric field part of the wave? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Magnetic field amplitude: \(B_0 = 320\text{ nT} = 3.20 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
In a plane electromagnetic wave, peak fields obey \(E_0 = c B_0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[E_0 = c B_0\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[E_0 = (3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}) \times (3.20 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}) = 96\text{ V/m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{m/s} \times \text{T} = \text{V/m}\). The electric field amplitude is \(96\text{ V/m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The electric field amplitude is \(96\text{ V/m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q11 - Wave vector from plane wave frequency

questiontext.text: A plane electromagnetic wave propagates in free space with a frequency of \(\nu = 60.0\text{ MHz}\). What is the propagation wave number \(k\) of this wave? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\) and \(\pi = 3.142\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Frequency: \(\nu = 60.0\text{ MHz} = 6.0 \times 10^7\text{ Hz}\).
Speed of light: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).
Constant: \(\pi = 3.142\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The wavelength is \(\lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\), and the wave number is \(k = \frac{2\pi}{\lambda} = \frac{2\pi\nu}{c}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[\lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\]\[k = \frac{2\pi}{\lambda}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate wavelength:
\[\lambda = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{6.0 \times 10^7\text{ s}^{-1}} = 5.0\text{ m}\]
Calculate wave number:
\[k = \frac{2 \times 3.142}{5.0\text{ m}} = \frac{6.284}{5.0} \approx 1.26\text{ rad/m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Units: \(\text{rad/m}\). The wave number is \(1.26\text{ rad/m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The wave number is \(1.26\text{ rad/m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q12 - Difference in wavelengths for tuning frequency band

questiontext.text: A radio receiver can tune in to any station in the frequency band from \(7.5\text{ MHz}\) to \(12.0\text{ MHz}\). What is the difference between the maximum and minimum wavelengths of this band in vacuum? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Minimum frequency: \(\nu_1 = 7.5\text{ MHz} = 7.5 \times 10^6\text{ Hz}\).
Maximum frequency: \(\nu_2 = 12.0\text{ MHz} = 1.20 \times 10^7\text{ Hz}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
The wavelength corresponding to each frequency is given by \(\lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[\lambda_{\text{max}} = \frac{c}{\nu_1}, \quad \lambda_{\text{min}} = \frac{c}{\nu_2}, \quad \Delta \lambda = \lambda_{\text{max}} - \lambda_{\text{min}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
\[\lambda_{\text{max}} = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{7.5 \times 10^6\text{ s}^{-1}} = 40.0\text{ m}\]
\[\lambda_{\text{min}} = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{12.0 \times 10^6\text{ s}^{-1}} = 25.0\text{ m}\]
\[\Delta \lambda = 40.0\text{ m} - 25.0\text{ m} = 15.0\text{ m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The wavelength range spans from \(25.0\text{ m}\) to \(40.0\text{ m}\), giving a difference of \(15.0\text{ m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
The difference between maximum and minimum wavelengths is \(15.0\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_ELECTROMAGNETIC_WAVES_MCQ_Q13 - Magnetic amplitude and wavelength from electric amplitude

questiontext.text: A plane harmonic electromagnetic wave has an electric field amplitude \(E_0 = 120\text{ N/C}\) and a frequency \(\nu = 50.0\text{ MHz}\) in vacuum. What are the amplitude of its magnetic field \(B_0\) and its wavelength \(\lambda\)? (Take \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Electric field amplitude: \(E_0 = 120\text{ N/C} = 120\text{ V/m}\).
Frequency: \(\nu = 50.0\text{ MHz} = 5.0 \times 10^7\text{ Hz}\).
Speed of light in vacuum: \(c = 3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Principles
In vacuum, field amplitudes and wave parameters obey \(B_0 = \frac{E_0}{c}\) and \(\lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae
\[B_0 = \frac{E_0}{c}\]\[\lambda = \frac{c}{\nu}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate \(B_0\):
\[B_0 = \frac{120\text{ V/m}}{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}} = 4.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\]
Calculate \(\lambda\):
\[\lambda = \frac{3.0 \times 10^8\text{ m/s}}{5.0 \times 10^7\text{ s}^{-1}} = 6.0\text{ m}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
\(B_0 = 4.0 \times 10^{-7}\text{ T}\) and \(\lambda = 6.0\text{ m}\).

Final Conceptual Answer:
